name: E2E-SEEDV-007 — 同一商品72小时内视频去重(DB端到端验证)
description: 验证同一商品在72小时去重窗口内只生产一次视频。通过DB查询f88_ai_process_record表验证：①seedVideoGenerate记录去重正确 ②同item_id同biz_type 72h内无重复PENDING ③retry_count>0的记录不影响去重判断 ④视频与图片链路去重独立
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功
打开F88策略列表(建立页面上下文)

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'db-validated-dedup', scenario: '视频72h去重', table: 'f88_ai_process_record', dedupWindowHours: 72, dedupWindowMinutes: 4320, videoProcessMode: 'seedVideoGenerate', imageProcessMode: 'seedGenerate', videoBizType: 'item_material', videoSceneType: 'generate', expectedRules: { firstEvent: '首次事件→PENDING记录落库', within72h: '72h内重复事件→filterAlreadyProcessed过滤→不新增记录', after72h: '72h后→允许再次生产', retryFilter: 'retry_count>0的记录不参与去重判断', statusFilter: 'main_status=COMPLETED或EXECUTING的记录阻止同recordId新记录', pipelineIsolation: '视频seedVideoGenerate与图片seedGenerate去重独立' } }; })()

steps.sql: SELECT record_id, item_id, seller_id, scene_type, biz_type, main_status, sub_status, retry_count, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM f88_ai_process_record WHERE scene_type='generate' AND biz_type='item_material' AND is_deleted=0 AND gmt_create > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) ORDER BY item_id, gmt_create DESC LIMIT 100
steps.description: 查询72h内所有素材生产记录(含视频)

steps.expression: (() => { const records = ${recent72hRecords}; if (!records || !records.rows) return { ok: false, error: 'DB查询无结果' }; const rows = records.rows; const itemCount = {}; const duplicates = []; for (const r of rows) { const key = r.item_id + '_' + r.biz_type; if (!itemCount[key]) itemCount[key] = []; itemCount[key].push(r); } for (const key in itemCount) { if (itemCount[key].length > 1) { const sorted = itemCount[key].sort((a,b) => new Date(b.gmt_create) - new Date(a.gmt_create)); const first = sorted[0]; const rest = sorted.slice(1); for (const dup of rest) { const hoursDiff = (new Date(first.gmt_create) - new Date(dup.gmt_create)) / 3600000; if (hoursDiff <= 72 && dup.retry_count == 0 && dup.main_status != 2) { duplicates.push({ item_id: dup.item_id, record_id: dup.record_id, hoursDiff: hoursDiff.toFixed(1), status: dup.main_status, retry_count: dup.retry_count }); } } } } return { totalRecords: rows.length, uniqueItems: Object.keys(itemCount).length, potentialDuplicates: duplicates.length, duplicates: duplicates.slice(0, 10) }; })()
steps.description: 分析72h内是否存在同商品重复生产记录
72h内同商品无重复生产记录(去重生效)

steps.sql: SELECT item_id, biz_type, COUNT(*) as record_count, MIN(gmt_create) as first_time, MAX(gmt_create) as last_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(gmt_create), MAX(gmt_create)) as span_hours FROM f88_ai_process_record WHERE scene_type='generate' AND is_deleted=0 AND retry_count=0 AND gmt_create > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY item_id, biz_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY record_count DESC LIMIT 20
steps.description: 查询7天内同商品多次记录(去重窗口外允许再次生产)

steps.expression: (() => { const records = ${multiRecords}; if (!records || !records.rows) return { ok: true, note: '7天内无同商品多次生产记录(商品活跃度低)' }; const rows = records.rows; const validRepeats = []; for (const r of rows) { if (r.span_hours > 72) { validRepeats.push({ item_id: r.item_id, biz_type: r.biz_type, count: r.record_count, span_hours: r.span_hours }); } } return { totalMultiRecords: rows.length, validRepeatsAfter72h: validRepeats.length, samples: validRepeats.slice(0, 5) }; })()
steps.description: 验证72h外允许再次生产(去重窗口过期)

steps.sql: SELECT item_id, biz_type, record_id, main_status, retry_count, gmt_create FROM f88_ai_process_record WHERE retry_count > 0 AND is_deleted=0 AND gmt_create > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY gmt_create DESC LIMIT 10
steps.description: 查询retry_count>0的记录(验证重试不影响去重)

steps.expression: (() => { const retry = ${retryRecords}; if (!retry || !retry.rows) return { ok: true, note: '7天内无重试记录' }; return { retryCount: retry.rows.length, samples: retry.rows.slice(0, 5).map(r => ({ item_id: r.item_id, biz_type: r.biz_type, retry_count: r.retry_count, status: r.main_status })) }; })()
steps.description: 验证重试记录存在且被正确标记

steps.sql: SELECT item_id, COUNT(DISTINCT biz_type) as biz_types, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT biz_type) as types FROM f88_ai_process_record WHERE scene_type IN ('generate','diagnose') AND is_deleted=0 AND gmt_create > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) GROUP BY item_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT biz_type) > 1 ORDER BY biz_types DESC LIMIT 10
steps.description: 查询同商品多biz_type记录(验证链路隔离)

steps.expression: (() => { const multi = ${multiBizItems}; if (!multi || !multi.rows) return { ok: true, note: '72h内无同商品多链路记录' }; return { multiBizItems: multi.rows.length, samples: multi.rows.slice(0, 5).map(r => ({ item_id: r.item_id, biz_types: r.types, count: r.biz_types })) }; })()
steps.description: 验证不同biz_type(链路)的记录互不干扰

_testDesign.preconditions: dms-alibaba CLI可连接scenario/prod; f88_ai_process_record表有近期数据; seedVideoGenerate功能可能尚未上线(用现有generate/item_material验证去重模式)
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.UI打开F88策略页 2.DB查72h内所有generate记录 3.分析同item_id同biz_type是否有72h内重复(排除retry_count>0) 4.DB查7天内同商品多次记录→验证72h窗口外允许再生产 5.DB查retry记录→验证重试不影响去重 6.DB查多biz_type记录→验证链路隔离
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①72h内同item_id+biz_type无重复PENDING记录 ②72h窗口外允许再次生产 ③retry_count>0的记录不参与去重 ④不同biz_type记录互不影响(链路隔离)
dbAssertions: 7天窗口外: 允许同item_id再次出现
不同biz_type: 独立去重互不干扰
riskPoints: seedVideoGenerate记录尚未入库(功能开关默认关),待上线后需重新验证
record_id格式为{itemId}_{sellerId},hashCode冲突可能导致误去重
时区偏差(服务端UTC+8 vs DB时间)影响72h窗口边界
分布式锁超时可能导致极端并发下重复生产
